- [ASSISTANT_CREATED] Assistant provided a list of recommended restaurants in Tokyo:
  1. Sukiyabashi Jiro (Sushi) - three-Michelin-starred institution in Ginza.
  2. Tsukiji Fish Market - offers a variety of fresh seafood and sushi options.
  3. Tofuya Ukai (Tofu) - historic restaurant specializing in tofu dishes in Shibuya.
  4. Yakiniku Jumbo Han no Daidokoro Bettei (Yakiniku/BBQ) - luxurious restaurant in Roppongi.
  5. Narisawa (Kaiseki) - two-Michelin-starred restaurant in Roppongi.
  6. Tofu Kichi (Tofu) - cozy tofu restaurant in Shimokitazawa.
  7. Toriki (Yakitori) - small restaurant serving yakitori in Shimokitazawa.
  8. Ginza Kyubey (Sushi) - renowned sushi restaurant in Ginza.
  9. Yoshitake (Kaiseki) - traditional kaiseki restaurant in Shibuya.
  10. Ichiran Shibuya (Ramen) - popular ramen chain in Shibuya.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] User should research and make reservations in advance for popular restaurants.
